title: zazzle-csharp-indexer internal tools
description: The tools zazzled calls by name with tools/call over the daemon socket; tools/list is empty, so clients are not shown them, and agents use the zazzle tools named below. Paths are root:relative/path; with one root the prefix may be left out. No tool checks who is calling: the daemon socket can only be opened by its owner, and the stdio server answers whoever started it.

entities.name: overview
entities.description: A compact map of a root: file and line counts by language, top-level directories, entry points and project files, largest files; agents ask for it with zazzle_overview.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the daemon or the stdio server.
entities.result: Five lines per root, computed from the index without reading file contents.
failures: Index still building after the ready timeout: error index_cold ("list files with zazzle_ls").

entities.name: find_symbol
entities.description: Declarations whose name contains (or equals, with exact) the query, case-insensitively, optionally of one kind; agents ask for it with zazzle_find_symbol.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call find_symbol {name, exact?, kind?, root?, limit?, offset?}
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the daemon or the stdio server.
entities.result: root:path:line kind container.name | signature, exact matches first, then by path; paged, 30 by default.
failures: Index still building: error index_cold ("search with zazzle_find").

entities.name: changed_since
entities.description: Files added, modified or deleted since a cursor; without a cursor, a starting cursor; agents ask for it with zazzle_changed_since.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the daemon or the stdio server.
entities.result: A|M|D root:path lines after a full reconcile of each root, then a new cursor epoch;root=gen;...
failures: Cursor from another engine run: "cursor expired (daemon restarted)" and a new cursor.
Change log no longer reaches back to the cursor: a line saying to re-list with zazzle_ls.

entities.name: git_log
entities.description: Recent commits, optionally for one path and filtered by message; agents ask for it with zazzle_git_log.
entities.transport: MCP tools/call git_log {path?, root?, n?, grep?}
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the daemon or the stdio server; the path is not resolved against the root (backlog.json, git-paths-unresolved).
entities.result: hash date author subject per commit, 20 by default.
failures: git exits non-zero: error git_failed with git's message.

entities.name: git_blame
entities.description: Who last changed each line of a range; agents ask for it with zazzle_git_blame.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the daemon or the stdio server; the path is not resolved against the root (backlog.json, git-paths-unresolved).
entities.result: git blame -w output for the range, 40 lines from start_line by default.
failures: git exits non-zero: error git_failed with git's message.

entities.name: view
entities.description: A terse behavioural view of one C# file, with its source line numbers; zazzle read asks for it through the daemon socket.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the daemon or the stdio server; the path is resolved with Root.Resolve, so it stays inside the root.
entities.result: A header "root:path N lines; terse: <count> <step>, ..." (or "nothing to shorten"), then the view: N for an unchanged line, N~ for a changed one, A-B with a note for collapsed lines (src/View/.dev/contracts.json, view-format). The file is read from disk, not through the index, and the usage log records path view.
failures: Several roots and no root prefix: error bad_path.
A path that leaves the root: error outside_root.
A file not ending in .cs: error not_csharp.

entities.name: report_gap
entities.description: The agent's one- or two-sentence note on what it could not get, or what was slow, wrong or too verbose; agents ask for it with zazzle_report_gap.
entities.authorization: None checked beyond being a client of the daemon or the stdio server.
entities.result: "recorded"; the note goes into the usage-log record's note field (cut to 500 characters), where zazzle-csharp-indexer report lists it.

relatedViews.relationship: The capability these operations make up.
zazzle calls these to answer the coding agent's code questions.
